notes: Core taste leans dreamy/art-pop, singer-songwriter, and left-field electronic/experimental (Bjork, Rosalia, Efterklang, Astrid Sonne). Actively branching into rockier/riot-grrrl-adjacent alt via a Spotify playlist called 'Red' — treat throwback_alt_reference_points as a genre/vibe signal, not literal booking matches (these acts won't play small NYC rooms currently, they're a taste reference). Not into straight-up club/DJ electronica (house/techno/dance sets) despite liking electronic-adjacent art-pop artists — see avoid_genres. Top-songs-2025 signal (The Sundays, AIR, Sade, Bread, Norah Jones, Joan Baez, Thee Sacred Souls, Wings, Alice Phoebe Lou, Thee Heart Tones, Addison Rae) adds a softer/warmer/retro throughline: jangle pop, sophisti-pop/soul, 60s-70s folk and soft rock, downtempo — broadens the 'dreamy' core beyond just art-pop into classic and retro-soul territory too.
